meta.name: Barun Rai and the House on the Cliff
meta.description: Newly-weds Soumili and Harmesh Banerjee have just moved into their dream home and life should be perfect. But their love is being tested by unexplained incidents. Enter Barun Rai, As his expertise lies in solving paranormal activities.

videos.title: Episode 1: Corvid's Head
videos.overview: Amid cliff suicides, Psychic officer Barun Rai is called in Corvid s Head. Newlyweds Soumili and Harman move into a new hill house

videos.title: Episode 2: The Previous Owner
videos.overview: Spooky forces creep into Soumili's home. Police and Barun investigate suicides and Father Paul has a strange relation to mishaps.

videos.title: Episode 3: Slideshow
videos.overview: Barun joins Soumili to find the riddle of the evil book and the vile force; while the sinister entity has other plans for Harmesh.

videos.title: Episode 4: Seperation
videos.overview: Soumili's world is shattered after a tragic mishap. Ominous activities in the house get stronger to overthrow Soumili and Barun.

videos.title: Episode 5: The Mentor
videos.overview: Barun digs deep into the history of the house. Father Paul must deal with the ghosts of the past and prepare to battle the demons.

videos.title: Episode 6: The Blood Moon
videos.overview: Barun asks father Paul to team up and resist the demonic possessions. Will innocent Soumili be lost forever at the hands of Satan?
